title: CoarseSoundNet: Building a reliable model for ecological soundscape analysis
abstract: arXiv:2605.21143v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A soundscape is composed of three types of sound: biophony (sounds made by animals), geophony (natural abiotic sounds) and anthropophony (sounds made by humans). A key research question in the field of soundscape ecology is how these components interact with each other, specifically how biophony responds to geophony and anthropophony. Nevertheless, as of today, there are not many analytical instruments that enable the distinct quantification of these elements. Recent machine learning (ML) approaches aim to support automated analysis but often rely on task-specific or clean data, limiting generalisation to noisy passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) recordings. This study presents a reproducible framework to build ML models for coarse soundscape classification and introduces CoarseSoundNet, a deep learning model trained to distinguish biophony, geophony, and anthropophony under realistic terrestrial PAM conditions. translated_title: CoarseSoundNet：构建用于生态声景分析的可靠模型
translated_abstract: 声景由三类声音组成：生物声（动物发出的声音）、地声（自然非生物声音）和人为声（人类产生的声音）。声景生态学领域的一个关键研究问题是这些成分之间如何相互作用，特别是生物声如何响应地声和人为声。然而，迄今为止，能够对这些成分进行区分量化的分析工具并不多。近来的机器学习方法旨在支持自动化分析，但往往依赖于特定任务或干净的数据，这限制了其对含噪被动声学监测（PAM）录音的泛化能力。本研究提出了一个可复现的框架来构建用于粗粒度声景分类的机器学习模型，并介绍了CoarseSoundNet——一个经过训练以在真实陆生被动声学监测条件下区分生物声、地声和人为声的深度学习模型。我们系统地……
tldr: 提出了CoarseSoundNet深度学习模型，能在真实含噪的陆生被动声学监测条件下区分生物声、地声与人为声，为生态声景的粗粒度分类提供了可复现的框架。
en_tdlr: CoarseSoundNet is a deep learning model that reliably distinguishes biophony, geophony, and anthropophony under realistic noisy passive acoustic monitoring conditions, providing a reproducible framework for coarse soundscape classification.
